audit.why: 62.25% over 204 games. Cho'Gath out-sustains Overload poke with Carnivore and owns levels 3-6; Ryze's danger is scaling, not lane. Existing early/mid text already frames it that way.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Level 1 and Level 6 to Ryze and 2+ items to Cho'Gath — the exact inverse of the truth, and it contradicted its own whys[] text (whys[0] says 'neither side can force', whys[6] says 'this window is his').
audit.why: Realm Warp (R, 180/160/140s) deals zero damage and is a delayed group portal, so Ryze gains no duel power at 6 while Cho'Gath gains a true-damage execute. Conversely Ryze is the hard scaler: Flux-empowered Overload at 1000 range beats a Feast health pool once he has two items. At level 1 he has only Overload and no Flux to root through, so neither side can commit.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, Level 6 Cho'Gath, 2+ items Ryze. Proposed as one atomic chart group across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two hard errors. (a) Rune Prison is called 'his point-blank root' in four places — it is a 615-range targeted ability that only ROOTS if Spell Flux is already on the target; without Flux it is a slow. (b) Feast is said to 'ignore his shield' twice — Ryze's kit contains no shield at all, and true damage is absorbed by shields anyway.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Ryze traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' Range 615, cooldown 11/10.5/10/9.5/9. Spell Flux is the 615-range, 3.5s-to-2.5s enabler that also resets Overload. Both of Ryze's damage spells (Q Overload, E Spell Flux) are projectiles. Ryze has no dash and no shield; Flash is his only escape. Cho'Gath's Feral Scream shares Rune Prison's exact cooldown line (11/10.5/10/9.5/9), so the two abilities trade one-for-one.
audit.corrected: Dodge the Spell Flux orb and Rune Prison is only a slow. Rupture (6s flat, 950 range) knocks up an immobile champion with no dash; Feral Scream's cone silence at 300 range cuts the Flux-Overload chain mid-cast.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named the punishable cooldown but gave no number and repeated the point-blank-root error.
audit.why: Rune Prison is 11s at rank 1 and Feral Scream is also 11s at rank 1 — the fight is decided by which 11s button is up.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the real number and the Flux gate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere states the Flux-gate ordering, which is the single decisive mechanic of the lane.
audit.why: A Cho'Gath who sidesteps the E orb simply cannot be rooted, and an unrooted Cho'Gath walks Ryze down because Ryze has no dash.
audit.corrected: Added to dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns.

notes: Cho'Gath kit file tags Rupture (Q) with flag grounding:'shuts off enemy dashes'. Riot's own description says it pops units into the air — it is a knockup, not a ground. Trusting the description per instructions; wording used is 'knockup' throughout. Level chart was proposed as one atomic group (3 side flips + 3 rating flips + matching content win[] flips).
